obligations.statement: When the storage delete rejects for one due recording, runRecordingRetentionSweep resolves and leaves that recording unpurged, so it is still due on the next sweep.
A single runRecordingRetentionSweep call purges no more due recordings than its batch bound, leaving the remaining due recordings unpurged for later sweeps.
A recording under legal hold is not purged and its storage object is not deleted, even when it is 2000 days old.
Each recording is judged against its own tenant's retention days: a 60-day-old recording is purged for a tenant with 30-day retention and kept for a tenant with 365-day retention.
